Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner initially assumed the composer of "Nulla in mundo pax sincera" was Claudio Monteverdi and identified his birthplace as Cremona, Italy, without verifying this information. This assumption led to incorrect queries and delayed the resolution of the task. Although the WebSurfer later corrected this by identifying Antonio Vivaldi as the composer and Venice as his birthplace, the initial incorrect assumption created confusion and inefficiency in the process.
